sales_invoice_lines_kind_ck.name: sales_invoice_lines_kind_ck
sales_invoice_lines_kind_ck.value: ("sales_invoice_lines"."kind" = 'GOODS' AND "sales_invoice_lines"."sku_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sales_invoice_lines"."metres" > 0 AND "sales_invoice_lines"."rate_per_m" IS NOT NULL) OR ("sales_invoice_lines"."kind" = 'CHARGE' AND "sales_invoice_lines"."charge_code" IS NOT NULL)

allocations_source_ck.name: allocations_source_ck
allocations_source_ck.value:
("allocations"."source" IN ('RECEIPT', 'PAYMENT') AND "allocations"."receipt_id" IS NOT NULL AND "allocations"."customer_note_id" IS NULL AND "allocations"."purchase_return_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("allocations"."source" = 'CREDIT_NOTE' AND "allocations"."customer_note_id" IS NOT NULL AND "allocations"."receipt_id" IS NULL AND "allocations"."purchase_return_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("allocations"."source" = 'DEBIT_NOTE' AND "allocations"."purchase_return_id" IS NOT NULL AND "allocations"."receipt_id" IS NULL AND "allocations"."customer_note_id" IS NULL)

commission_payouts_paid_ck.name: commission_payouts_paid_ck
commission_payouts_paid_ck.value: ("commission_payouts"."status" = 'Paid') = ("commission_payouts"."paid_on" IS NOT NULL AND "commission_payouts"."payout_no" IS NOT NULL)

receipts_party_ck.name: receipts_party_ck
receipts_party_ck.value:
("receipts"."party_type" = 'CUSTOMER' AND "receipts"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "receipts"."supplier_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("receipts"."party_type" = 'SUPPLIER' AND "receipts"."supplier_id" IS NOT NULL AND "receipts"."customer_id" IS NULL)

receipts_reversal_ck.name: receipts_reversal_ck
receipts_reversal_ck.value: ("receipts"."status" = 'Reversed') = ("receipts"."reversed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "receipts"."reversal_kind" IS NOT NULL)
